title: Exotic Spicy Moroccan Lamb Msemen
description: A winey and springy Moroccan dish featuring lamb, ketchup, and stir-fry elements, perfect for a date night, served in a msemen form.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the ketchup, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the msemen dough according to package instructions or recipe.
Assemble the msemen by placing a piece of dough on a flat surface and spooning the lamb mixture onto the center of the dough.
Top with chopped dates and parsley, and fold the dough to enclose.
Serve the exotic spicy Moroccan lamb msemen hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
